subject: Prepay onboarding: activation checkpoints, invoice cutoffs & withdrawal windows
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@brightdata.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Annual prepay / activation windows and VAT notes

Hi Sean / Kimberly,

Thanks for the initial call this morning. Attached is our PO and a short note on our fiscal timing (BrightData_PO_2027.pdf). To summarize BrightData's asks:

- We want a single annual prepayment (committed spend) that will be invoiced up front but drawn down monthly.
- We need clear invoice cutoff dates so our AP team can schedule transfers and reconcile VAT for the EU entities.
- Prefer quarterly invoice copies for internal audits and a single monthly drawdown ledger (CSV).

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can you confirm the typical invoice date you use when you issue an annual prepay (invoice date vs. remit effective date)?
2) Do you provide VAT-broken invoices for EU subsidiaries or a single invoice with VAT evidence attached?
3) What are the standard withdrawal windows (e.g., monthly on the 1st / 15th) you support for drawdown?

We'd like to lock the activation window (funds received --> credits active) to be within 3 business days after funds clear, with automated replenishment notifications.

Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Finance Ops, BrightData Inc.
elena@brightdata.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: BrightData_PO_2027.pdf (pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@brightdata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Annual prepay / activation windows and VAT notes

Elena — thanks for the note and the PO. Looping in Kimberly from Finance to propose a concrete cadence. Quick answers up front:

- Invoice dating: for upfront prepay we typically issue the invoice with the contract effective date (invoice date = funding date). If you need a different invoice_date for AP purposes we can accommodate with a die-down note.
- VAT handling: we can either issue country-level VAT invoices per subsidiary or a single gross invoice plus an attached VAT evidence bundle — whichever your tax team prefers.
- Withdrawal windows: standard options are monthly on the 1st (default), monthly on the 15th, or a rolling daily sweep (for large commits). We recommend the 1st for predictability.

I'll attach our standard prepay terms for your procurement review (redwood_prepay_terms_v1.pdf). Kimberly — can you propose a draft invoice schedule (dates + numbering pattern) and the drawdown report format we should deliver?

Next step: once we align on invoice_date and withdrawal window we'll generate the commitment amendment for signature and queue the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_prepay_terms_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@brightdata.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Annual prepay / activation windows and VAT notes

Hi Elena / Sean —

Draft invoice & drawdown plan below (happy to iterate):

1) Invoice policy
- Invoice date: Invoice will show Funding Date (the date funds clear into Redwood bank account).
- Invoice numbering: RDW-BD-2027-<SEQ> where <SEQ> = 001 for the annual prepay invoice and then monthly drawdown statements as RDW-BD-2027-DR-<MM>.
- VAT: We will issue a country-level VAT invoice for each jurisdiction you specify. If you prefer a consolidated invoice + VAT evidence bundle we will include a separate per-subsidiary VAT pack in the portal.

2) Drawdown windows (recommended)
- Monthly standard: funds allocated on 1st of month; ledger/report generated within 24 hours.
- Buffer: if funds are received in last 3 business days of prior month we will apply to next month by default unless you request pro-rata application.
- Escrow/holding: We can support a short-term escrow hold (up to 10 business days) before activation for compliance reviews; specify if required.

3) Reports & evidence
- Monthly drawdown CSV: columns = date_credited, sku, token_count, amount_charged, remaining_balance. (See attachment invoice-schedule-SEQ.csv)
- VAT evidence checklist attached (VAT-evidence-checklist.docx). We can also deliver quarterly audit packs via secure Drive link on request.

Action items:
- Elena: confirm which BrightData legal entities (US / UK / DE) need VAT invoices and whether you'd like country-level or consolidated invoices.
- Sean: once Elena confirms, I'll prepare the commitment amendment and invoice numbering.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Accounting Manager — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: invoice-schedule-SEQ.csv (csv), VAT-evidence-checklist.docx (docx)
From: Elena Torres <elena@brightdata.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Annual prepay / activation windows and VAT notes

Thanks Kimberly — this is exactly what we needed. Quick clarifications:

- Entities: Please issue VAT invoices for BrightData US, BrightData EU (BrightData Ltd, UK), and BrightData DE (Germany). We prefer country-level VAT invoices.
- Withdrawal window: we'd like to shift to a mid-month drawdown (15th) to align with our payroll cycles. Is that doable?
- Escrow: we do not require an escrow hold. If funds clear on or before the 13th they should be applied to the 15th window.

Also looping our AP mailbox (finance@brightdata.com) in case they need to confirm remittance details — they'll provide bank wiring instructions and the authorized signer for the PO.

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Commitment amendment & ops checklist (DocuSign + runbook)

Hi all — following Kimberly / Sean's threads I've prepared the commitment amendment and the ops checklist to lock timelines. Summary & action items below: 

Summary decisions:
- Annual prepay invoice issued on funding date (Funding Date = date funds clear).
- Withdrawal window confirmed: monthly on the 15th; funds received on/ before 13th apply to the 15th.
- VAT invoices will be issued per-country for US / UK / DE.

Action items / links:
1) Elena / AP: sign the commitment amendment via DocuSign here: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEF-12345 (DocuSign envelope RDW-BD-2027-AMD).
2) AP (finance@brightdata.com): please send wiring instructions and named authorized signer for the PO to kimberly_park@redwood.com.
3) Redwood OPS: we'll enable monthly automatic drawdown reports (CSV) to be emailed to finance@brightdata.com on the 16th (for the previous 15-day window).
4) Quarterly audit packs: Kimberly to deliver on request; Sean to confirm cadence with customer success post-launch.

I'm attaching the amendment (docusign-amendment-12345.pdf) and will kick the DocuSign envelope once we have wiring details. Proposed go-live: activation within 3 business days of funds clearing after signature.

Thanks — Priyom
